title: The Organstator
features:
Custom Morph based off a person's art in the discord

NOTE: This is obviously client sided the only thing people see is the king grumble morph and if you want a more normal version here ya go

local args = {
    "KingGrumbleGlitch"
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RemotesFolder"):WaitForChild("CharChange"):FireServer(unpack(args))

task.wait(1)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tentaclesFolder = workspace[player.Name].Tentacles

local keep = {TentacleD = true, TentacleF = true}

for _, tentacle in ipairs(tentaclesFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if not keep[tentacle.Name] then
        tentacle:Destroy()
    end
end

local args = {
    "KingGrumbleGlitch"
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("RemotesFolder"):WaitForChild("CharChange"):FireServer(unpack(args))

task.wait(1)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tentaclesFolder = workspace[player.Name].Tentacles

local keep = {TentacleC = true, TentacleG = true}

for _, tentacle in ipairs(tentaclesFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if not keep[tentacle.Name] then
        tentacle:Destroy()
    end
end
